resolution.note: handoff rewrites run-index.md in the same write; test/state/write.test.ts creates a run after index, handoff, check has no orphaned-run

title: Handoff refreshes the run index it points at
body:
Source: lane report for #1164 (319c950, t-s2y8xs0): `krn state handoff` does not refresh run-index.md, so a run created after the last `krn state index` is reported orphaned at the next session start.
Outcome: `krn state handoff` rewrites the capsule's run-index.md in the same write, so `krn state check --root .` right after a handoff reports 0 orphaned-run errors.
Why: the delivery-handoff skill must not need a second command an agent will forget.
Proof: a state test creates a new run directory, runs the handoff writer, then check reports no orphaned-run.
Files: src/state/write.ts, test/state/write.test.ts
